headline: Russian Missile Strike Hits US-Owned Bunge Sunflower Oil Plant in Dnipro
summary: A Russian strike damaged a Bunge-owned sunflower oil processing plant in Dnipro, marking the third attack on the facility this year. Russian strikes have increasingly targeted Ukrainian food processing infrastructure.
why: Bunge is a global agribusiness and food ingredient company listed in the United States.

impacts.name: Bunge
impacts.why: Physical facility damage disrupts Bunge's agricultural processing operations in Ukraine.
